title: identity
description: Who the agent is: the name it answers to, what it is, and how it introduces itself. One document per workspace, written by the host and read by the runtime before every turn.

name.description: The name the agent answers to, in the company's language.

englishName.description: The same name for readers who do not read the company's language.

handle.description: The machine handle people mention the agent by.

aliases.description: Other spellings people use for the name.

role.description: One line on what the agent is for at this company.

creature.description: What the agent is, when it has a form: a mascot, an animal, a character.

emoji.description: The emoji that stands for the agent.

introduction.description: How the agent introduces itself when asked who it is.
